records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue increased for the year ended December 31, 2023, by $185 million, or 8.7%, when compared to the corresponding period of 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The average price of Hot-Rolled Coil declined 19.1% (from $1,097.24 per short ton to $887.47 per short ton) in 2023 compared to 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The price for WTI crude was $73.69 per barrel at January 19, 2024, down 5.1% from the 2023 average.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The average price of WTI crude declined 18.1% (from $94.79 per barrel to $77.64 per barrel), and natural gas prices declined 60.4% (from $6.42 per MMBtu to $2.54 per MMBtu) in 2023 compared to 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2023, operating profit was $140 million compared to operating profit of $131 million for the corresponding period of 2022.
